SELECT c.category, e.course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM enrollments e
JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
GROUP BY c.category, e.course_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
  SELECT MAX(t.cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM enrollments e2
    JOIN courses c2 ON c2.id = e2.course_id
    WHERE c2.category = c.category
    GROUP BY e2.course_id
  ) t
)
ORDER BY c.category;

SELECT c.category, c.id AS course_id, COUNT(e.id) AS enrollment_count
FROM courses c
JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.category, c.id
HAVING COUNT(e.id) = (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(e2.id) AS cnt
    FROM courses c2
    JOIN enrollments e2 ON e2.course_id = c2.id
    WHERE c2.category = c.category
    GROUP BY c2.id
  )
)
ORDER BY c.category;

SELECT c.category, c.id AS course_id, COUNT(e.id) AS enrollments
FROM courses c
JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.category, c.id
HAVING COUNT(e.id) = (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(e2.id) AS cnt
    FROM courses c2
    JOIN enrollments e2 ON e2.course_id = c2.id
    WHERE c2.category = c.category
    GROUP BY c2.id
  )
)
ORDER BY c.category;
